items.title: Google Cloud services face outage in London, Revolut services down too
items.brief: Multiple Google Cloud services experienced disruptions in the company’s London region on Tuesday, according to its service status page, while British digital bank Revolut also reported a service outage.

items.title: Oil parked above $110 a barrel as IEA warns energy markets won’t return to normal next year
items.brief: Global energy markets are more than a year away from returning to normal and remain highly vulnerable to “overlapping crises” in the Middle East, the head of the International Energy Agency has warned.

items.title: Canary in the coal mine or just a bad apple? CoreWeave debt drama roils Wall Street
items.brief: Wall Street is increasingly scrutinizing the massive debt companies are taking on to fund the artificial intelligence boom.

items.title: ‘There’s a hunger to express yourself’: A dispatch from China’s most fashionable city
items.brief: One of China’s most exciting art curators, X Zhu-Nowell, is giving me a very Shanghai morning.

items.title: Several French cities impose curfews after weekend of chaos and protests spreading to parts of Europe
items.brief: French officials are imposing localized curfews — including in parts of Paris — as the country grapples with the fallout from its worst rioting in years.

items.title: Driver charged with ramming Australian lawmaker with car in ‘targeted’ attack
items.brief: A 43-year-old man has been charged over an alleged ramming attack on an Australian lawmaker that police say was “targeted” and left her serious injuries that media reports say required the amputation of her leg.

items.title: US-Ukraine relationship worsens amid Trump and Zelensky’s mutual distrust
items.brief: The relationship between Ukraine and the United States is facing increasing strain over intelligence sharing, sanctions, Ukrainian attacks on Russian energy and the path to peace.
